title: Earth, Wind & Fire - After The Love Has Gone [31G]

lines.l: Baby will say, something happened all the other way, and yesterday was all we had, and oh, after my love is gone, how could you leave me up, when my love is fair enough, oh, after my love is gone.
To say this was all we shared
Same thing ever along the way
How could you lay me up
When you're willing to stay around
Used to be right as wrong
And love is lost and found
Used to be right as wrong
And love is lost and found
Our love is aflame, burning within. Now and then, firelight will catch us, snumbling in.
